info.title: Kurbis Control Plane API
info.description: Browser JSON API. OAuth callbacks are redirects, server events use SSE, and export downloads stream ZIP data. Worker and gateway protocol routes are intentionally private.

get.description: Begin a provider-link redirect for the authenticated account.
Complete OAuth and redirect with an account session cookie.

post.description: Redeem a one-use Minecraft login token; account session cookies are set when signing in.
Redeem a one-use server login token and set a persistent, server-scoped browser grant cookie.
Queue one server console command for the current online placement and return its durable execution record.

reserved_micros.description: Worst-case cost of model calls that are still in flight.

AiEffort.description: How much the model thinks before answering.

AiJobDetail.description: One request with every tool call it made.

AiJobEventKind.description: Chat line delivered to the requesting operator.

input_micros_per_mtok.description: Micro-USD per million uncached input tokens.

available.description: Whether the control plane has a model provider configured.

monthly_budget_micros.description:
Monthly spending cap for this server in micro-USD, at most the
 account's monthly budget.

AiSyncRequest.description:
One plugin poll: return finished tool results, receive new calls and chat
 lines.

after_event_id.description:
Last event id the plugin has seen. Omit it on the first sync: the
 plugin then receives only the lines of requests still running.

cursor.description: Pass back as `after_event_id` on the next sync.

AiToolCall.description: One tool call as recorded for the owner's audit trail.

AiToolCallRequest.description: A tool call the plugin must execute as the requesting operator.

AiToolCallState.description: Execution state of one tool call requested by the model.

AiUsage.description: This calendar month's (UTC) usage of one server and its owner's account.

query.description:
Matches names, developers, categories and descriptions; at most 64
 characters are used.

name.description:
Java names are resolved with Mojang. Bedrock names resolve only while
 the player is online on this server or already has a stored roster entry.

PluginSource.description: Where an installed plugin came from.

PluginState.description:
Whether the runtime runs the installed binary. `pending` means the
 runtime has not loaded this binary yet; a sleeping server loads it when
 it next starts.

file_name.description: The uploaded file's name; its stem names the plugin.

generation.description: The placement generation that produced this sample.

measured_at.description: Assigned by the control plane when the sample is persisted.

Canonical lifecycle command wire format at
 `POST /api/v1/servers/{server_id}/commands`.

ServerIdPath.description:
A server id extracted from the request path together with the canonical
 server row.  Authorization remains actor-specific and is performed by the
 handler/command service; this extractor only normalizes path lookup and the
 not-found response.

ServerPlugin.description: One plugin installed on a server.

error.description: Why the runtime could not load this binary.

market_plugin_id.description: The market listing this plugin was installed from.

runtime_name.description: The name and version the plugin reported when the runtime loaded it.

synchronized.description: Whether a running server has loaded the current list.

name.description:
The Minecraft name to resolve. Java names are looked up through Mojang;
 Bedrock names resolve only from this server's live players or stored roster.
